text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is frustrating! I just couldn't 
seal the win!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Your strategy was flawless,
yet I couldn't 
pull off that final push...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's just proof of how inexperienced I 
still am.
choice_data_list: Still, that was an amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: Still, that was a fantastic race!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Clashing with rivals where nobody knows 
who's gonna win—that thrilling tension is 
the best!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Just thinking back on it makes my heart 
race and my body burn up..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We had such a fiercely contested, 
passionate match. I feel like giving a 
big, heartfelt hug to every single girl 
who ran with me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, it's still not enough. If I am to 
bear the title of Queen,
nothing less than 
a flawless victory will suffice!"

Next time, for my fans, and for my
